title: Patch: a card's cosmetic picks show in more places, sooner, and Created cards wear their generator's picks
thread:
**Issue #1956 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1956: Patch: a card's cosmetic picks show in more places, sooner, and Created cards wear their generator's picks
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Two changes to how the viewer's per-card cosmetic picks (foil, finish, border, full art; R1655000, R1295000, R1313000, R1833000) are worn. Both are presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Nothing reaches an action, the log, a replay or another player's view.

**1. Picks show in more places, sooner.**

Today R1655000 (*Who wears them*) puts a card's picks only on the viewer's own copy on a board they play, that copy's inspect overlays (`OwnCopy`), and the Collection's single-card view (`collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx`). Everywhere else draws the defaults. So a player equips a foil in the Collection, goes back to the grid and sees a plain card. Extend where the viewer's own picks are worn:

- **The Collection's owned-cards grid** (`collection/OwnedCards.tsx`): an owned tile wears that card's picks, with the account fallback. A locked silhouette stays plain.
- **The deck builder's pool grid and deck list tiles** (`game/deckbuilder/PoolGrid.tsx`, `CardBrowser.tsx`, `DeckWorkshop.tsx`). Today R1655000 says these "draw the defaults", although `routes/decks.tsx` already wraps them in `OwnCopy own`.
- **The Almanac** (`routes/almanac.tsx`): when the viewer is signed in, a card they own wears its picks, behind the same ownership `FullArtOwned` / `AccountCosmeticsOwned` gives the gated screens (`cards/ownedFullArt.ts`). The Almanac currently mounts no ownership, so "every" counts as owned, and that must not let an unowned stored pick show. A signed-out viewer, and any card they do not own, sees the defaults as now. The Almanac stays public and asks the server nothing it doesn't already ask.
- **Immediately, across tabs:** the account picks store (`COSMETICS_SETTINGS_KEY`) and the per-card store (`CARD_PICKS_SETTINGS_KEY`) in `cards/cosmetics.ts` notify only their own tab. Add a window `"storage"` listener (re-read, then notify), as `audio/settings.ts` and `stats/store.ts` do. A pick made in one tab then shows in every open Collection, deck builder, Almanac and board without a reload. Within a tab, every surface above must update on the same render as the pick, with no remount or refetch.

The rarity rules hold everywhere: a Mythic face wears no cosmetic foil, and a Radiant face no foil, finish or border. An opponent's copy, a watched game, a replay, the homescreen fan and Discover-style offered options still draw the defaults (§14.2: the client never infers another's cosmetics).

**2. Created cards wear their generator's picks.**

A card one of the viewer's cards makes during a game (a token summoned, a card added to hand or deck, a Discover once chosen: anything `CardInstance.created` marks, R943) has its own `defId`, so it finds no per-card picks and falls back to the account's. It should instead wear the foil, finish and border its **generator** wears, so a foil Hoarder's tokens are foil too.

- The engine does not record a Created card's generator today (`crates/engine/src/state.rs` `CardInstance` has `created: Option<bool>` and no source). Add the generator's catalog id, e.g. `created_by: Option<String>` holding the generating card's `def_id`, set wherever an instance is minted with `created`. Expose it on `CardView` / `UnitView` (and the other views that carry `created`) under the same visibility rule as `created`: only on a card the viewer may read. Regenerate `apps/web/src/wire/`.
- **Chains:** a Created card made by a Created card carries the root generator (copy `created_by` through, not the intermediate's `def_id`), so a token's token still wears the original card's picks.
- **What is inherited:** foil, finish and border, resolved as the generator's own copy would wear them (its per-card picks, else the account's), and only where the viewer owns them **on the generator** (`ownsCosmetic(owned, generatorDefId, id)`). A full art is not inherited, because it is a cosmetic made for one card (`card` in the registry). The Created card's own rarity rules still apply to its face.
- A Created card with no generator (minted by a rule, or with a generator the client can't resolve) keeps today's behaviour.
- **State hash and replays:** a new state field changes what is hashed for every game that creates a card. Check `cargo jackioh golden check`, the replay hashing in `cargo jackioh fuzz` and the shipped-catalog replay folding (R767000). Either keep the field out of the hashed state, if the engine has a way to do that for presentation-only data, or regenerate what the repo's tooling regenerates, and say which in the PR. No golden trace is edited by hand.

This amends R1655000 (*Who wears them*), so it needs a new ruling note in this issue's block, one for each of the two changes, or a single note if that reads better. The PR must not change how any card plays: the classifier should label it `kind:app` with no pending fragment. If `rust (classify)` flags plays from the new field, that means the field is leaking into play and must be fixed, not claimed.

### Acceptance

- An owned Collection grid tile wears its card's foil, finish and border picks, falling back to the account picks. A locked tile and a Radiant tile do not. Proved in `collection/collection.test.tsx` under the new ruling's id.
- The deck builder's pool and deck-list tiles wear the viewer's picks. R1655000's text no longer says they draw the defaults.
- A signed-in Almanac wears picks only on cards the ledger says the viewer owns. Signed out, or with an unowned stored pick, it draws the defaults. Proved by test.
- A `storage` event on either cosmetics key re-renders a mounted face with the new pick, with no reload (vitest, jsdom).
- Engine: a rules test (`cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules <ruling id>`) shows that a token or card created by card A carries `created_by == A`, that a card created by that token also carries A, that a non-Created card carries none, and that the field reaches the view only where `created` does (never on an opponent's hidden hand card or face-down backrow).
- Web: a Created card on the viewer's own board, whose generator has a foil/finish/border pick the viewer owns, wears it. The same card on the opponent's side, in a replay or in a watched game draws the defaults. A full-art pick is not inherited.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`, `golden check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, `classify --base origin/main --claims` and the five required checks are green. The wire diff is committed.

### Blocked by, part of

Related: #1655 (per-card picks), #1662, #1955 (equip from the pack reveal), #1953.
```
